source: d41 global farm practices refire (cnc-ps07-d41-global-farm-practices-refire.content.md), R1-R16 registry, section 5.2

rules.name: Official-alert lock
rules.action_template: Official {alert_type} for {hazard} at {district}: issued {issue_time}, valid until {validity}. Relay the official wording verbatim. Notify the village relay and the extension desk. Confirm receipt.
rules.deadline_logic: Relay immediately on receipt; never hold for aggregation. Validity window starts from the official issue time.
rules.guardrail: Never paraphrase a watch as a warning. The platform relays IMD and CWC signals; it never issues a competing cyclone warning.

rules.name: Redundant last mile
rules.practice: People-centered early warning (preparecenter) and Ama Krushi delivery pattern
rules.action_template: Send concise SMS for {hazard} at {district}; place an Odia IVR call; retry on no acknowledgment; notify the trusted village contact; offer a live agent. Record acknowledgment, not merely delivery.
rules.deadline_logic: Escalate after one unacknowledged delivery window. Latency budget per action decides the rung: 1h window = IVR plus radio, 6h window = SMS.

source.title: Strengthening Early Warning Systems for All

rules.guardrail: No single channel reaches everyone. A message is acknowledged only when the farmer confirms, not when it is delivered.

rules.name: Flood-safe seed
rules.practice: Practical Action safe grain storage, Bangladesh and South Asia
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: dry and label your seed; seal an inner container; move it above the predicted water; duplicate a lot at a second safe site or the community store before water arrives.
rules.deadline_logic: Complete before forecast water reaches the storage elevation. Minimum lead 12h.

source.title: Safe Grain Storage in Flood Prone Area

rules.guardrail: Jute sacks and earthen pots alone are not floodproof. Never claim a store is flood-safe without elevation above forecast water.

rules.name: Livestock movement plan
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: identify animals and owners; move early by species order; carry fodder, medicines, and a clean-water plan; confirm head count at the destination shelter.
rules.deadline_logic: Route-cutoff time minus movement lead. No universal fixed lead time; use route, species, daylight, handlers, and shelter capacity.

source.title: Guidelines for Managing Livestock in Flood Emergencies

rules.guardrail: Local shelter capacity, routes passable at forecast water, species handling times, and owners must be confirmed before movement.

rules.name: Livestock water safety
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: block water that floodwater may have contacted; use a tested or approved clean supply; monitor animals; request veterinary help if any animal drinks contaminated water.
rules.deadline_logic: Immediately on floodwater contamination, before animals drink again.

source.title: Keeping farm animals and horses in extreme weather

rules.guardrail: Floodwater can contain sewage, manure, and chemicals; drinking-water access is assessed separately from flood depth.

rules.name: Submergence-tolerant paddy planning
rules.practice: Swarna-Sub1 flood-tolerant rice, J-PAL randomized trial in Odisha
rules.action_template: Preseason {farm_name}: offer Swarna-Sub1 or the locally approved equivalent with duration, seed availability, and the district recommendation for freshwater submergence risk.
rules.deadline_logic: Preseason before the sowing decision; replanting must close before the season window ends.

source.title: Reducing Farmers' Risk through Flood-Tolerant Rice in India
source.org: J-PAL / Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab

rules.guardrail: Swarna-Sub1 is not a salinity or wind solution. Requires approved local seed and a district recommendation.

rules.name: Lodging-risk varietal score
rules.action_template: Preseason {farm_name}: rank approved varieties by lodging resistance, maturity, yield, and local trial performance for cyclone-prone {district}.

source.title: Identification of a Major Locus for Lodging Resistance to Typhoons in Rice

rules.guardrail: Japanese research informs the ranking criterion; it does not make a Japanese variety automatically suitable for Odisha.

rules.name: Seasonal floating-rice or rice-fish pilot
rules.practice: Floating rice plus fish, Mekong Delta, Vietnam
rules.action_template: Seasonal pilot only ({farm_name}): extension-supervised flood admission, elongating variety, fingerlings released after inundation, joint rice-fish harvest. Disclose the yield trade-off.
rules.deadline_logic: Seasonal, before flood onset; gated by an extension supervisor.

source.title: Floating Rice: Sparkling Hopes for Water and Sediment Preservation

rules.guardrail: Rice yield is one-half to one-third of high-yielding varieties [31]; hydrologic dependence must be disclosed. Never activate for cyclone surge.

rules.name: Floating vegetable bed
rules.practice: Baira / dhap floating gardens, southern Bangladesh
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: build a locally tested floating bed recipe from clean plant residue, anchor it, grow the recommended vegetable and spice list, and follow the sanitation warning.
rules.deadline_logic: Build before waterlogging onset while water is low; minimum lead 12h.
rules.guardrail: Do not recommend invasive or contaminated hyacinth; Nigerian evidence shows harm in aquaculture [26]. Not a substitute for paddy acreage.

rules.name: Raised bed plus perimeter drainage
rules.practice: Chinampas (Mexico) and waru waru (Peru) raised-field systems
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: raise the root zone, route water through maintained perimeter channels, stabilize edges, and inspect after heavy rain.
rules.deadline_logic: Before the monsoon; inspect after each heavy rain.
rules.guardrail: The geometry is the inspiration; dimensions require Odisha trials. Permanent land modification requires owned or long-term tenancy.

rules.name: Flood-recession sowing gate
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: sow an approved short-duration crop in the falling-water window while the soil is wet but workable, so it matures before the next hazard.
rules.deadline_logic: Within the window after water withdrawal; the crop must mature before the next hazard.

source.title: Large rice-based irrigation systems in Cambodia

rules.guardrail: Never advise solely because satellite water area shrank; require moisture, salinity, contamination, tenure, and crop-duration checks.

rules.name: Drain-pond integration
rules.practice: Mulberry-dyke fish-pond (China) and cotton tail-water recycling (Australia)
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: capture manageable field drainage into the pond, prevent fish escape, and reuse water only after quality and overflow checks.
rules.deadline_logic: During monsoon preparation; before overflow checks.

source.title: Zhejiang Huzhou Mulberry-dyke and Fish-pond System

rules.guardrail: Agrichemical and disease risks require local limits; overflow must not flood downstream fields.

rules.name: Community tank and ditch maintenance
rules.practice: Cascaded tank-village system (Sri Lanka) and subak governance (Bali)
rules.action_template: Assign desilting, gate, bund, culvert, and outlet tasks to named water-user groups; log completion before the first heavy rain.
rules.deadline_logic: Pre-monsoon completion; before the first heavy rain.

source.title: Cascaded Tank-Village System in the Dry Zone of Sri Lanka

rules.guardrail: Governance is the transferable mechanism; major civil works need engineers and permits.

rules.name: Controlled overflow corridor
rules.action_template: Protect designated drainage corridors and overflow zones from obstruction; this triggers authority action, not an individual farmer action.
rules.guardrail: Requires compensation, land-use authority, and hydraulic modeling. Individual farmers are not the actor.

rules.name: Post-flood damage to assistance
rules.action_template: {farm_name}: photograph and geotag crop, seed, livestock, pond, bund, fence, and drainage damage; triage contamination; clear debris safely; restore drainage; route the claim and input support.
rules.deadline_logic: Start after authorities declare access safe. PMFBY intimation clock is 72 hours from the damaging event (ODISHA-MEASURED).
rules.guardrail: Mirrors the USDA debris-to-reseeding sequence [29]. Claim intimation within 72h; PMFBY yield-loss threshold 33%.

rules.name: Evidence quarantine
rules.action_template: Administrator only: show 'research lead - no farmer advisory' with the source, mechanism, hazard fit, and approval status; send nothing to farmers.
rules.deadline_logic: None; permanent until evidence is supplied and locally approved.

source.title: Global flood and cyclone farm wisdom (real-vs-filler and noise log)

rules.guardrail: Prevents unsupported labels from becoming dangerous farmer instructions.
